##### Project general facts

Diva at the Bay is a beautifully imagined mid-rise residential address that blends serene, private contemporary living with the vibrant energy of urban life. Set across two connected buildings, Diva A and Diva B, each with its own lobby, lifts and lifestyle facilities, the development offers a wonderful sense of exclusivity and community all at once. Residents can choose from a delightful selection of studios, 1 bedroom junior, 2 bedroom, 2 bedroom duplex and 3 bedroom apartments, most of which enjoy breathtaking views over the crystal-clear Arabian sea.

Life at Diva at the Bay is elevated by a wealth of upscale amenities designed for both relaxation and wellbeing. Extravagant lobbies in both towers welcome you with mood lighting, guest waiting areas and lush green gardens, while three fast elevators in each tower, multiple parking areas and round-the-clock security ensure everyday comfort and peace of mind. A state-of-the-art gym, swimming areas and private terrace pools in select units make it effortless to stay active and unwind without ever leaving home.

Every residence is finished to an impeccable standard, with premium detailing carried through from the kitchen to the bathrooms and all living spaces. Thoughtful features include built-in wardrobes, central air conditioning, floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows, fully tiled bathrooms, vanity units with mirrors and elegant kitchen cabinetry. State-of-the-art fixtures and fittings give each room a warm, luxurious feel that makes coming home a true pleasure.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated on Yas Island, a scenic island surrounded by crystal-clear waters and dotted with some of Abu Dhabi's most iconic landmarks, offering unforgettable experiences that enliven all the senses. The area combines an unsurpassed quality of life with an innovative business environment, making it one of the most desirable places in the world to live and work. The city is known for its modern skyscrapers, traditional culture, and amazingly diverse population from all different nationalities.

The waterfront development offers a spectacular boardwalk with restaurants and sparkling views of the Arabian Gulf, along with a vibrant pier opposite a five-star hotel. The area is home to a state-of-the-art event space and a series of exceptional dining experiences featuring renowned international concepts. Residents can enjoy a vibrant culinary scene with diverse options ranging from lounge bars to fine dining establishments.

The neighborhood boasts golden sands, turquoise seas, and a dynamic waterfront lifestyle that appeals to both residents and visitors alike. The area's world-class entertainment, dining, and leisure options create a truly immersive living experience. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of island tranquility, urban convenience, and unparalleled lifestyle amenities, offering an unmatched living experience in one of Abu Dhabi's most iconic destinations.
